programme.title: The Chocolate Queen

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: A trip to a prehistoric cave site with drawings dating back 20,000 years gets host Sarah Sharratt thinking about the earliest hunters and gatherers, man and fire, and the fundamental need we still have to source and cook our food. In this season finale, Sarah hosts a BBQ party for her visiting family and new French friends.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie is cooking up four more outrageously tasty dishes. To get it all going he’s sharing his Sicilian Tuna Pasta – one of the fastest family suppers you can make – followed by his stunning dish with attitude: Sticky Teriyaki Eggplant.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt is invited by her local mayor to accompany him on a seasonal pigeon hunt; a tradition that dates back hundreds of years in the region. The hunters inpire Sarah to throw a dinner party featuring stuffed pigeon on roasted fennel and pommes dauphinoise (potato gratin). For dessert Sarah makes an apple tresse with armagnac, another traditional ingredient she sources from a famous local producer.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Have a good repertoire of icings and glazes add flair and panache your cakes and cookies. Here we get a handle on the major styles and some delicious recipes where they are used.
